description: 13F security summary by CUSIP: holder count, aggregate value and shares for one quarter, the holder-count and aggregate-value trend for every served quarter (2024Q3-2026Q2), and the quarter's ranked top holders. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/finance/13f/security/{cusip}.

limit.description: Holder list page size, default 25, cap 200

quarter.description: Quarter, one of the served quarters 2024Q3-2026Q2; default is the latest served quarter (2026Q2)

name: finance_13f_security
